overview.description: The Tema Photonics & Optical ETF (LAZR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund actively manages a global portfolio of stocks identified by the Adviser as belonging to the photonics and optical industry, which includes companies involved in the design, development, manufacturing, production, and distribution of photonics or optical products. LAZR was launched on Jun 30, 2026 and is issued by Tema.
